$comment: Every function listed here holds SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, which bypasses
RLS and can reach all public tables. This file records what each one
ACTUALLY touches, measured from source on 2026-08-14 against deploy tip
e1214d3df. The checker fails on any reach not declared here, and equally on
a declaration that no longer matches reality.
Declaring a cross-domain reach here does NOT bless it. It records it, with a
justification, so the Convex-vs-Postgres comparison argues from a measured
number instead of a capability claim. Do not widen a function's domain to

domains.money: Billing, subscriptions, Paddle, founders, referrals, AI credit ledgers
domains.ai: AI Doctor and AI Coach request handling
domains.ingest: Sensor ingest, bridge tokens, ingest audit
domains.grower: Diary, grows, plants, tents, profiles, gamification
domains.cross: Legitimately spans domains; exempt from the cross-domain report

ai-coach.justification: Reads grower and sensor context to build the coach prompt. AGENTS.md requires AI Doctor/Coach to use as much context as available, so this cross-domain read is intended, not drift. It is also the single widest AI-domain reach and would be the hardest function to move behind a restricted role.

ai-doctor-review.justification: Zero direct table access; all writes go through SECURITY DEFINER RPCs. This is the shape a restricted role would find easiest to fence.

delete-account.justification: Account erasure legitimately spans domains. Named in the spec §5.5 as the case a restricted role cannot improve — a role for it would be service_role with extra steps. Exempt from the cross-domain report by design.

ecowitt-ingest.justification: Reads tents (grower) to route a reading to its tent. Narrow and structural to ingest.

operator-ggs-real-payload-commit.justification: Reads tents (grower) for routing, same shape as ecowitt-ingest. Operator-gated.

pi-ingest-readings.justification: Holds a service-role client via readEnv in buildDefaultLookupClient but has no literal .from/.rpc target in its own source. Zero measured reach is not zero capability — this is precisely the blind spot a static scan cannot close.

redeem-referral.justification: Reads profiles (grower) to resolve the referred user. Genuine cross-domain reach from a money function.

rls-selftest.justification: A self-test harness that deliberately probes RLS across nine tables in four domains. Widest reach of any service-role function. Legitimately cross-domain — it exists to test the fences — but it is also the clearest example of why one shared service_role identity has no natural boundary.
